create.name: Odeya Nini
create.bio:
Odeya Nini is a vocalist and composer living in Los Angeles. Her path ran from youth theatre through songwriting and jazz improvisation into experimental and chamber composition, and finally into a solo practice built around the unaccompanied voice. She has performed at the LA Phil, the Broad and Merkin Concert Hall, and abroad in Tel Aviv, Australia, Mongolia, Madagascar and Vietnam; her album ODE was picked by The New Yorker among the notable recordings of 2022, and she sings with the new-music ensemble Wild Up.

Alongside performing, she taught yoga for thirteen years and has guided vocal sound meditations since 2012. Her Free the Voice approach asks students to notice how sounding feels in the body rather than judging how they sound, working with breath, toning, improvisation, movement, visualisation and call and response. She teaches it through a 26-lesson online course, group workshops in Los Angeles and New York, private lessons and residential retreats at Esalen. Her Voice Bath meditations layer live vocals with singing bowls, gongs and chimes while listeners lie down and rest.

courses.title: Free the Resonant Voice: A Vocal Embodiment Journey to Remember the Soul of Your Sound
courses.description: A five-day residential workshop at Esalen in Big Sur on finding a freer, fuller voice. Sessions use sensing, imagery, movement and playful vocal exercises, and include some hands-on contact and group embrace.

courses.title: Free the Voice: Journey to Remember Your Sound
courses.description: A self-paced online course of 26 recorded voice lessons released week by week, with monthly open group calls. It builds from breath work to toning, improvisation and imagery, aimed at people who were told they could not sing as much as trained singers.

courses.title: Workshop - FREE THE VOICE :: NYC 11/16
courses.description: A two-hour evening group session in Brooklyn introducing her vocal embodiment method through movement and improvised sound. No singing experience is needed.

courses.title: Embodied Voice Private Lessons
courses.description: One-to-one voice sessions shaped around each student. Work can include breathing, toning, tuning, call and response, theatre exercises, improvisation, meditation and song.

courses.title: Voice Bath
courses.description: A lying-down group or private sound meditation in which she sings layered harmonies and overtones over Himalayan and crystal bowls, gong and chimes. Usually held in yoga studios, sometimes in galleries, domes or caves.

free_resources.title: Free the Voice Free Lesson
free_resources.description: A sample lesson from her online voice course, offered in return for a short email sign-up on the course home page.

flags: Email odeyanini@gmail.com is published as the mail icon (mailto link) in the header of every odeyanini.com page, including Contact; there is no address written out in text.

Much of her public output is concert music (composer, Wild Up ensemble); most of her YouTube channel is performance and music videos, so only two videos qualify. Teaching runs through freethevoice.com and voicebath.com.
Prices for the private lesson and Voice Bath come from 'Gift' products in her odeyanini.com store ($180 for 60 min, $250 for 75 min); the lesson and Voice Bath pages themselves show no price.
Online course price is behind a Kajabi checkout that returned a Cloudflare block, so it is given as Contact for pricing.
Her sites and the Esalen page frame voice work as healing and 'medicine' in places; descriptions here avoid that wording.
